meta.title: Gurunanak Jayanti (Prakash Gurpurb) 2026 - position-taking windows for all NSE F&O stocks

method.backtest_period: 2000-2025 (26 events) on adjusted daily closes; each stock gets its own best side (LONG/SHORT) and window chosen over entry 1-8 and exit 1-8 trading days, by win rate then average return, needing at least 7 valid years
method.window_definition: 'T-N to T+M': enter at the close of the N-th trading day before the holiday, exit at the close of the M-th trading day after it. Trading days follow the NSE calendar (24-Nov-2026 holiday, 10-Nov-2026 closed).
method.grades: STRONG: at least 10 valid years, win rate >=75%, positive average return, walk-forward win rate >=60%. MODERATE: win rate >=65%, positive average return, walk-forward >=50%. Otherwise NO_TRADE. DATA_INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 7 valid years.
method.walk_forward_evidence: none = no walk-forward trades (fewer than 8 earlier years to pick from); thin = fewer than 5 walk-forward trades, so walk_forward_win_rate_pct is not statistically meaningful; adequate = 5 or more. Positions graded MODERATE can carry thin/none evidence - treat those as the least validated.
method.walk_forward: The side/window is re-picked every year using only earlier years and traded the next year; walk_forward_win_rate_pct is the honest, out-of-sample view and is far lower than the in-sample win rate on average.
method.short_rule: A SHORT counts as a position only with at least 15 valid years and walk-forward win rate >=60%.
method.times_ist: entry 09:20 and exit 15:15 follow the dashboard convention; the backtest itself is close-to-close.
method.futures_margin: margin_20pct_rs = 20% x lot size x last close (closes in the data end mid-October 2026). Lot size is blank for ENRIN, ANANDRATHI and UJJIVANSFB (not available in the source data); all three are NO_CALL.
